quote: The Spence Concentrator Upgrade Recovery project, which upgrades the flotation circuit to increase residence time and improve recoveries, was sanctioned in June 2026, with first production expected during FY28… The Spence Chalcopyrite Leaching project was also sanctioned in June 2026, which includes the implementation of BHP’s sulphide leaching technology, Simple Approach to Leaching 2… with first production expected in CY28.
